title: Android NAT-T keepalive offload bypasses VPN lockdown
summary: A Mullvad blog post and Hacker News discussion revealing that Android's NAT-T keepalive offload feature can leak traffic outside a VPN tunnel, even when VPN lockdown mode is enabled. The flaw allows packets to bypass the VPN's kill switch, undermining a core privacy guarantee. Commenters debate the root cause, Android's offload design, and potential mitigations.
